Name: Star Signs
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img] [/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Star signs is a simple astrology mod that lets you blame the stars for your bad luck. Each sign has buffs and debuffs that can affect your playthrough. During the timeframe that your sign is active, your buffs double. Based on their birthdays, all NPCs who have a birthday will get a sign as well. Their compatibility with your sign can make it easier or harder to gain friendship with them. The difficulty can be changed in the configuration.[/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img] [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]This should be compatible with all custom NPCs. If not, I'll figure that out later[/color]


[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img] [/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Install the latest version of [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8](Optional but Recommended) Install [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Run the game using SMAPI. Choose either a new or existing game and enjoy.[/color]

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]This can be used on a new or existing save. This has NOT yet been tested in multiplayer or Mobile.
[/color]Code is available for reference via [url=https://github.com/Huskyn1nja/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/StarSigns]GitHub[/url]
